item.title: Create documents for your tabletop RPG campaign in LaTeX
item.description: I wanted to create an introductory document for a Dungeons and Dragons campaign that we want to start soon. It should give my players an idea what to expect during the adventure and in what universe their characters will act. Using LaTeX to create a beautifully typeset PDF seemed like an obvious choice. I use git to track changes over time, LaTeX for typesetting, and the DND-5e-LaTeX-Template to make the document visually interesting as well.
